exposure: type of anaesthesia (general/neuraxial converted to general)
cohort: 85 patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who underwent cesarean hysterectomy
finding: In women undergoing cesarean hysterectomy for PAS, neuraxial anaesthesia converted to general anaesthesia had equivalent intra-operative outcomes compared to general anaesthesia alone, but was associated with improved post-operative outcomes, specifically a shorter total post-operative length of stay.
